description_en: Queries the result of asynchronously creating a workflow instance
description_zh: 查询异步创建工作流实例的结果
name: GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult

parameters.help_en: The operation ID. This parameter is used to query the result of asynchronously creating a workflow instance. You can call the CreateWorkflowInstances operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 操作ID，用于异步查询创建工作流实例的结果，可通过CreateWorkflowInstances接口获得
parameters.name: operation_id

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Result.description_en: The creation result of the workflow instance

FailureMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only if the creation fails
FailureMessage.description_zh: 失败消息。创建失败后，返回该字段

Status.description_en:
The creation status. Valid values:

Creating

Created

CreateFailure
Status.description_zh:
创建状态。
Creating，创建中
Created，创建成功
CreateFailure，创建失败

UnifiedWorkflowInstanceIds.description_en: Unified workflow instance ID. For all task instances triggered under the same data timestamp in a single trigger, the value of this field is identical. This field is returned after successful creation
UnifiedWorkflowInstanceIds.description_zh: 统一工作流实例Id，某次触发下某业务日期内的所有任务实例的该字段值相等。创建成功后，返回该字段

WorkflowInstanceIds.description_en: The workflow instance IDs. This parameter is returned only if the creation is successful
WorkflowInstanceIds.description_zh: 工作流实例ID列表。创建成功后，返回该字段

WorkflowTaskInstanceIds.description_en: The list of task instance IDs corresponding to the workflow instance. This field is returned after successful creation
WorkflowTaskInstanceIds.description_zh: 工作流实例对应的任务实例ID列表。创建成功后，返回该字段

items.description_en: The task instance ID corresponding to the workflow instance
items.description_zh: 工作流实例对应的任务实例ID
